en.title: European Digital Accessibility Standard Released, Shaping Global Inclusive Tech
en.summary: The new European Standard EN 301549 on digital accessibility has been published, providing updated guidelines for inclusive technology. In parallel, HUD set a deadline for fair housing accessibility complaints, Jubilee Lake Trail restoration began, pool‑specific wheelchairs launched, and Courtney Vargas advocated for independent living.

highlights.title: New European Standard on digital accessibility is out
Fair housing construction accessibility complaints now have a deadline, HUD says
Major accessibility restoration project underway at Jubilee Lake Trail
Despite Accessible Ramps, Why Can't Disabled People Enter Pools? First Batch of Pool-Specific Wheelchairs Fills the Gap

zh-TW.title: 歐洲發布新無障礙數位標準，多國無障礙項目同步推進
zh-TW.summary: 歐洲殘疾人論壇發布更新的 EN 301549 數位無障礙標準，為科技無障礙提供新指引。同時，HUD 宣布公平住房無障礙申訴期限，朱比利湖步道修復啟動，國內首批水池專用輪椅上市，且 Mirairo ID 獲更多日本企業接受用於殘障折扣。

highlights.title: 新版歐洲數位無障礙標準 EN 301549 發布
公平住房建設無障礙申訴現在有期限，HUD 說明
朱比利湖步道無障礙修復項目正在進行中
